انجلين (form VII)
# اِنْجَلَيْنَ (injalayna) /in.d͡ʒa.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
# اِنْجَلِينَ (injalīna) /in.d͡ʒa.liː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْجَلَى (injalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
